dedupe_keys.name: u s geothermal district heating systems and funding data nrel doe geothermal data repository

description: This dataset holds detailed information on geothermal district heating (GDH) systems across the United States, compiled by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory and posted to the DOE Geothermal Data Repository through the DOE Data Explorer in November 2020. Per system it records state, site, location, operational years, temperature, flow rate, capacity, energy use, load factor, original, updated and operational costs, funding sources, employment impact and project status, and it lists contributions to GDH systems such as federal, state and local grants and loans from agencies including USDA and the U.S. Department of Energy. The record describes the dataset as a resource for analysing the economic and technical landscape of geothermal district heating in the United States. Coverage is national, with the number of systems not stated on the page read. Access: DOE Data Explorer with DOI 10.15121/1764506, free; the page carries the OpenEI CC BY 4.0 notice, and the file format was not listed. Caveats: a single 2020 release with no update schedule stated. It suits techno-economic and funding analyses of heat networks, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
